example.title: Simple AutoCAD Connection
example.description: Basic connection to AutoCAD and document access
example.code:
import pythoncom import win32com.client
def connect_to_autocad(): """Connect to running AutoCAD instance""" try: pythoncom.CoInitialize() acad = win32com.client.Dispatch("AutoCAD.Application") print(f"Connected to AutoCAD {acad.Version}") return acad except Exception as e: print(f"Failed to connect: {e}") return None
def get_active_document(acad): """Get the active document""" try: doc = acad.ActiveDocument print(f"Active document: {doc.Name}") return doc except Exception as e: print(f"Failed to get document: {e}") return None

example.title: Create Circle
example.description: Create a circle in model space
example.code:
import array import pythoncom
def create_circle(model_space, center, radius): """Create a circle in AutoCAD model space""" try: # Convert center point to VARIANT array center_variant = pythoncom.VT_ARRAY | pythoncom.VT_R8, array.array('d', center)
# Create the circle circle = model_space.AddCircle(center_variant, radius)
print(f"Created circle with radius {radius} at {center}") return circle except Exception as e: print(f"Failed to create circle: {e}") return None
# Usage acad = connect_to_autocad() if acad: doc = acad.ActiveDocument model_space = doc.ModelSpace
# Create circle at origin with radius 5 circle = create_circle(model_space, [0, 0, 0], 5.0)

example.title: Create Line
example.description: Create a line between two points
example.code:
def create_line(model_space, start_point, end_point): """Create a line in AutoCAD model space""" try: # Convert points to VARIANT arrays start_variant = pythoncom.VT_ARRAY | pythoncom.VT_R8, array.array('d', start_point) end_variant = pythoncom.VT_ARRAY | pythoncom.VT_R8, array.array('d', end_point)
# Create the line line = model_space.AddLine(start_variant, end_variant)
print(f"Created line from {start_point} to {end_point}") return line except Exception as e: print(f"Failed to create line: {e}") return None
# Usage line = create_line(model_space, [0, 0, 0], [10, 10, 0])

def create_multiple_circles(model_space, circle_data): """Create multiple circles from list of center/radius pairs""" circles = [] for center, radius in circle_data: circle = create_circle(model_space, center, radius) if circle: circles.append(circle) else: print(f"Failed to create circle at {center}")
print(f"Created {len(circles)} out of {len(circle_data)} circles") return circles
# Usage circle_specs = [ ([0, 0, 0], 5.0), ([10, 0, 0], 3.0), ([0, 10, 0], 4.0) ]
